articles.title: Gencom-Led JV Buys InterContinental in Downtown Miami for $300M
articles.narrative: A joint venture led by Gencom and White Bridge Capital has acquired the InterContinental Miami hotel for approximately $300 million. The 34-story, 652-key waterfront property, located in downtown Miami, was sold by China's Dajia Insurance Group, which had owned the asset since 2005. The buyers noted the hotel's recent capital investment, strong operating performance, and diversified business mix as key drivers for long-term value creation.

data_points.notable_features: Waterfront property facing Biscayne Bay, just south of the Brickell district, with 90,000 square feet of event space and a rooftop pool.
data_points.project_notes: The seller recently renovated the property.

articles.market_intelligence: Blackstone acquired the 352-room East hotel in the area last year.

articles.title: Weil, Gotshal’s Collapse Is Perfectly Timed for Manhattan’s Office Market
articles.narrative: The impending dissolution of white-shoe law firm Weil, Gotshal & Manges, which occupies 447,000 square feet at BXP's General Motors Building, presents a significant opportunity for the Manhattan office market. Despite the firm's lease commitment until 2034, the sudden availability of this Class A space is well-timed given the borough's booming office market, characterized by strong leasing activity and rapidly shrinking supply for trophy assets. Market experts anticipate voracious demand for the space, potentially allowing BXP to secure significantly higher rents than the current in-place rate, which is reportedly under $150 per square foot, compared to current trophy asking rents approaching $200 per square foot.

data_points.address: 767 Fifth Avenue, New York City, NY
data_points.project_notes: Weil, Gotshal & Manges last renewed its lease in 2014 and is committed until 2034. BXP owns 60% of the building, acquired in 2008 in a joint venture.

people.name: Matthew Schreck
people.title: Research Director for the New York Tri-State Area

articles.market_intelligence: Manhattan's office market saw 33.5 million square feet of leasing activity through Q3 2026, a 5.6% increase year-over-year. Office availability is at 12.4%, marking the 10th consecutive quarter of tightening inventory. Sublet availability in Manhattan fell to 10.07 million square feet in August, a 22.3% contraction over the past year. Class A asking rents throughout Manhattan are up 9.9% year-over-year, with Midtown trophy availability under 2% and average asking rents approaching $200 per square foot.

articles.title: Irvine Company Secures $157M Multifamily Refi in L.A.’s Playa Vista
articles.narrative: Irvine Company has secured a $157.2 million refinancing loan from Capital One for its 309-unit luxury apartment property, Villas at Playa Vista – Montecito, located in Los Angeles' Playa Vista neighborhood. This new Fannie Mae loan replaces a previous $136 million loan, increasing the financing by approximately $21 million. The property, which opened in 2016, offers one- and two-bedroom apartments and a range of amenities.

data_points.notable_features: Luxury apartment community with a swimming pool, fitness center, coworking space, and conference rooms.
data_points.project_notes: The 2.6-acre site was previously acquired by Irvine Company from Brookfield in 2015. The property is part of the larger 460-acre Playa Vista master-planned development.

articles.market_intelligence: The Playa Vista master-planned development includes over 6,000 apartments, approximately 3 million square feet of office space, and more than 200,000 square feet of retail.

articles.title: Grassroots Analytics Doubles D.C. Footprint With 25K-SF Office Lease
articles.narrative: Grassroots Analytics has significantly expanded its presence in Washington, D.C., by signing a 24,692-square-foot office lease across three floors at Arch Square. This relocation more than doubles the company's footprint in the city and brings the office component of the mixed-use property to full occupancy. The deal highlights continued demand for well-located office space in the current market.
articles.market_intelligence: D.C.'s office leasing volume increased 21 percent in Q3 compared to the same period last year.

articles.title: Juda Chetrit Seals $55M Recap for 1384 Broadway
articles.narrative: The Chetrit Organization, led by Juda Chetrit, has secured a $55 million loan from Maxim Capital Group to recapitalize its 204,034-square-foot office building at 1384 Broadway in Midtown Manhattan. The financing will fund lobby renovations, amenity upgrades, and lease-up efforts for the 80 percent occupied tower. This transaction follows the building's previous $88 million CMBS loan entering special servicing in December 2025, with the new capital facilitating a discounted payoff.

data_points.project_notes: The loan includes capital for lobby renovations, upgraded amenities, and lease-up. A previous $88 million CMBS loan hit special servicing in December 2025, and this new financing completes a discounted payoff.

articles.title: Queens’ Tallest Tower Reaches 90% Leased, Adds First Retail Tenants
articles.narrative: The Orchard, a 70-story residential tower in Long Island City, Queens, has reached over 90% leased for its 824 residential units within nine months of launching. The development also secured its first three retail tenants, totaling more than 7,468 square feet, which are expected to open in 2027. This rapid leasing success underscores strong demand for the mixed-use project, which aims to serve both residents and the wider Long Island City community.

articles.title: Immersive Museum Will Make U.S. Debut at OCVIBE
articles.narrative: An immersive art museum by the art collective teamLab will establish its first permanent U.S. location within OCVIBE, a 100-acre sports, entertainment, and arts district currently under construction in Anaheim. The purpose-built museum will span approximately 110,000 square feet and is designed to integrate art as a central experience within the master-planned district, rather than just an amenity. This addition is expected to enhance OCVIBE's appeal as a cultural destination.

data_points.notable_features: First permanent U.S. museum for teamLab; purpose-built for immersive art experience.
data_points.project_notes: The museum will be part of the larger OCVIBE district, which is currently under construction.

articles.title: 80-Unit Seniors Housing Development Opens in Suburban Chicago
articles.narrative: Leyden Senior Apartments, an 80-unit independent senior living development, has opened in Franklin Park, IL. Developed by Evergreen Real Estate Group, the four-story building offers one- and two-bedroom residences and is complemented by the adjacent Carl Fiorito Senior Center. The project was designed with accessible floor plans and energy-efficient features, with Evergreen also managing leasing and property management.

data_points.address: 2506 N. Mannheim Road, Franklin Park, IL
data_points.notable_features: Adjacent to the newly constructed Carl Fiorito Senior Center, accessible floor plans, energy-efficient appliances, on-site amenities.
data_points.project_notes: The Carl Fiorito Senior Center will be available to the entire community.

articles.title: Woodcliff Lake Retail Center Trades for $109M in Move from Legacy Ownership
articles.narrative: Tice's Corner, a prominent lifestyle retail center in Woodcliff Lake, NJ, has been sold for $109.5 million. The transaction involved WS Development acquiring the property from WS Tice's Inc., marking one of New Jersey's largest single-asset retail sales in the last decade. The center, anchored by a major tech retailer, boasts a strong tenant mix and is situated in an affluent, supply-constrained market, presenting significant long-term growth potential for the new owner. The sale was a highly competitive process, concluding quickly without broad market exposure due to the asset's generational ownership.

data_points.address: 441 Chestnut Ridge Rd., Woodcliff Lake, NJ
data_points.notable_features: Anchored by a major tech retailer and features a curated mix of leading national lifestyle brands.
data_points.project_notes: This was a generational retail asset held by the same legacy ownership for decades.

articles.title: 312-Unit Multifamily in Indiana Changes Hands
articles.narrative: The Bend Apartments, a 312-unit garden apartment community in Clarksville, Indiana, was sold to a private investor. Northmarq's Investment Sales team represented the regional multifamily developer in the transaction. The property's recent construction, scale, and strategic location near major transportation arteries and employment centers contributed to strong investor interest, reflecting robust demand for institutional-quality multifamily assets in the Louisville metropolitan area.

data_points.notable_features: Conveniently located near shopping, national retailers, Green Tree Mall, and Interstates 65 and 265, with proximity to River Ridge Commerce Center and downtown Louisville.

articles.market_intelligence: The Louisville MSA shows consistent long-term growth in market fundamentals, attracting significant investor demand for institutional-quality multifamily assets.

articles.title: UK Budget Risks Deterring Sovereign Wealth Funds From Real Estate
articles.narrative: The UK government's recent budget changes to tax rules for sovereign wealth funds could significantly deter these major global investors from allocating capital to the country's real estate market. Sovereign wealth funds have historically been a crucial source of foreign direct investment in UK property, and the altered tax landscape may reduce their appetite for future acquisitions, potentially impacting market liquidity and asset valuations.

articles.title: Orchard Partners Selects JLL To Market 892K SF Manufacturing Campus In Brisbane: The San Francisco Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: Orchard Partners has selected JLL to market the Quarry Innovation Center, an 892,000-square-foot manufacturing campus in Brisbane. The project aims to balance conservation efforts with industrial requirements, offering a significant industrial footprint in the market.

data_points.notable_features: Campus designed to balance conservation and industrial needs.

articles.title: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. Could Expand In North Texas
articles.narrative: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. is reportedly evaluating the Dallas-Fort Worth area for a significant expansion, potentially developing up to six semiconductor manufacturing facilities. Each facility is estimated to cost $20 billion, representing a substantial investment in the region's industrial capacity.

data_points.project_notes: Each facility is estimated to cost $20 billion.

articles.title: Credit Union Breaks Ground On New HQ Building: The Houston Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: Wellby Financial has broken ground on its new headquarters building in Friendswood, Texas. The project signifies the credit union's commitment to the Houston market and its future growth.
